pr_title: planner: not pruning column used by union scan condition
pr_body:
<!-- Thank you for contributing to TiDB!

PR Title Format:
1. pkg [, pkg2, pkg3]: what's changed
2. *: what's changed

-->

### What problem does this PR solve?

Issue Number: close #21607 <!-- REMOVE this line if no issue to close -->

Problem Summary:

```sql
drop table if exists t;
create table t (a int, b int);
begin;
insert into t values (1, 2);
select count(*) from t where b = 1 and b in (3);
```
```console
ERROR 1105 (HY000): Can't find column test.t.b in schema Column: [test.t._tidb_rowid] Unique key: []
```

Copy from https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/issues/21607#issuecomment-741659275:

> - Absurdity conditions like `where b = 1 and b in (3)` build a `TableDual` operand with schema `[_tidb_rowid]`.
> - When the optimizer resolves indices, `PhysicalUnionScan` also resolves the indices of columns in the condition (it is `[b]`). 
> 
> Since the column `b` is not found in schema `[_tidb_rowid]`, an error is reported.
> ```console
> ERROR 1105 (HY000): Can't find column test.t.b in schema Column: [test.t._tidb_rowid] Unique key: []
> ```

The schema of `TableDual`(`[_tidb_rowid]`) is inheritated from `DataSource`. When `pddSolver` do predicate-push-down optimization, condition `where b = 1 and b in (3)` is optimized to `0` by `PropagateConstant`. Thus, the `columnPruner` prunes column `b` further. Finally, the schema of `DataSource` becomes `[_tidb_rowid]`.

### What is changed and how it works?

This PR extract the columns in the condition of `LogicalUnionScan` and prevent them from pruning. In this way, the schema of `TableDual` will be `[_tidb_rowid, b]`.

Alternative solutions:
 - Remove unused columns in `UnionScan` condition. We can do `PropagateConstant` on the conditions of `UnionScan`, but this will change the explain info and break a lot of tests.

What's Changed: Omitted.

How it Works: Omitted.

N/A

- Integration test

issue_context.title: Aggregation on table with absurdity selection in transaction reports 'column not found'
comments:
After preliminary investigation, here are a few facts about the first case.
- Absurdity conditions like `where b = 1 and b in (3)` build a `TableDual` operand with schema `[_tidb_rowid]`.
- When the optimizer resolves indices, `PhysicalUnionScan` also resolves the indices of columns in the condition (it is `[b]`). 

Since the column `b` is not found in schema `[_tidb_rowid]`, an error is reported.
```console
ERROR 1105 (HY000): Can't find column test.t.b in schema Column: [test.t._tidb_rowid] Unique key: []
```

## Please edit this comment or add a new comment to complete the following information

### Bug

Note: Make Sure that 'component', and 'severity' labels are added
Example for how to fill out the template: https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/issues/20100

#### 1. Root Cause Analysis (RCA) (optional) 
<!-- Write down the reason why this bug occurs -->

In a transaction, the condition of `UnionScan` is not optimized with `PropagateConstant`.  

When the optimizer resolving indices after physical optimization, it try to resolve the column in condition against schema(which is optimized with `PropagateConstant` and `PruneColumns`). 

As a result, the target column may not be found in the schema. For details, see https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/pull/21640.


#### 2. Symptom (optional)

<!-- What will the user see when this bug occurs. The error message may be in the terminal, log or monitoring -->
```console
ERROR 1105 (HY000): Can't find column test.t.b in schema Column: [test.t._tidb_rowid] Unique key: []
```

#### 3. All Trigger Conditions (optional)

<!-- All the user scenarios that may trigger this bug -->
- In a transaction
- the `where` clause contains absurdity that can be handled by `PropergateConstant`

#### 4. Workaround (optional)

Try to rewrite the SQL manually until no `PropergateConstant` is used.
